item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud dpal chen khrag 'thung lha brgyad bzlog pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan lcags phag lo'i zla tshes nyin par las/ sbas pa'i rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon phyogs mkha' 'gro seng gdong phug nas/ rigs mthun gyi DAk+ki grogs dang bcas te spyan drangs nas/ slar zla tshes la bsod nams stobs kyi rgyal po'i pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse nas mkha' 'gro'i shog ser bod yig du (tu) bsgyur ba grub pa'o//
